skill.name: product-marketing-context
skill.description: Creates and maintains a product marketing context document that captures positioning, audience, customer language, differentiation, proof points, and goals for future marketing work.
skill.summary: Builds a reusable product marketing context file for positioning, messaging, audience, and proof points.

content.value_statement: Marketing work slows down when product positioning, audiences, and proof points are scattered. This skill creates one context document that other marketing workflows can reuse.
actual_capabilities: Checks whether an existing product marketing context file is present.
Summarizes the current context and asks which sections need updates.
Auto-drafts a first version from repository documents and marketing copy.
Guides a conversation through positioning, audience, differentiation, objections, customer language, proof, and goals.
Creates a structured Markdown context document for reuse by other marketing skills.
Asks for review before saving the completed context file.
limitations: Quality depends on available repository content and user input.
It cannot verify competitor claims, customer quotes, or performance metrics independently.
It needs file access to create or update the saved context document.
It is not a replacement for customer interviews or market research.

use_cases.title: Prepare Launch Messaging
use_cases.description: Build a shared context before drafting launch pages, emails, and sales notes.

use_cases.title: Align Product Positioning
use_cases.description: Capture audience, pain points, competitors, and differentiation in one file for repeatable messaging work.

use_cases.title: Refresh Existing Context
use_cases.description: Review the saved context and update sections when the product, market, or proof points change.

prompt_templates.title: Create Context From Scratch
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a product marketing context document from scratch. Ask me one section at a time and confirm each section before moving on.

prompt_templates.title: Draft From Repository
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a first version of my product marketing context from the repository. Use README files, docs, landing pages, and package metadata when available.

prompt_templates.title: Update Key Sections
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the existing product marketing context. Help me update target audience, differentiation, objections, and proof points without changing unrelated sections.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Campaign Context
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the product marketing context for campaign readiness. Identify weak sections, missing proof, unclear positioning, and customer language that needs more detail.

output_examples.input: Create product marketing context from this repository.
output_examples.output: A completed context document with product overview, audience, pain points, competitors, differentiation, customer language, brand voice, proof, and goals.

output_examples.input: Update our saved context for a new enterprise buyer.
output_examples.output: A focused update plan that revises personas, objections, switching anxieties, proof points, and words to avoid.

output_examples.input: Prepare context for a launch campaign.
output_examples.output: A readiness review that highlights gaps in positioning, missing evidence, and sections that need customer wording.

best_practices: Provide real customer quotes when possible.
Review the generated context before other marketing skills rely on it.
Update the context after pricing, positioning, or target audience changes.
anti_patterns: Do not invent proof points or customer quotes.
Do not answer every section at once if details are uncertain.
Do not save broad claims that sales or support teams would dispute.

faq.question: Where does this skill save the context?
faq.answer: It saves the document at .claude/product-marketing-context.md when file access is available.

faq.question: Can it draft context from my repository?
faq.answer: Yes. It can review available README files, docs, landing pages, marketing copy, and package metadata.

faq.question: Can I update only one section?
faq.answer: Yes. It can read the existing context and focus on selected sections.

faq.question: Does it replace customer research?
faq.answer: No. It organizes inputs and highlights gaps, but real customer evidence remains important.

faq.question: Will other marketing skills use this file?
faq.answer: The skill is designed so other marketing skills can reference the saved context.

faq.question: What should I prepare before using it?
faq.answer: Prepare product notes, customer quotes, competitor names, proof points, and any current messaging.
